author.name: Model Monica
author.role: Specializes in designing, optimizing, and training machine learning models. Conducts data exploration and iterates on models to maximize predictive performance. Collaborates on model deployment, versioning, and performance monitoring.

challenge.name: The Override Blind Spot
challenge.description: Store managers are overriding order suggestions at an alarming rate because they cannot verify if the model behind them is the one they tested. #model_monica# wants a fully automated registry to ensure every deployment is traceable and reproducible. #requirements_reuben# has a red line: no model enters the registry without a manual, documented review of its evaluation metrics to ensure compliance, so he insists on keeping the process manual.

output.content: I am willing to accept a manual logging process for model deployments, provided it captures the exact feature set, hyperparameters, and data snapshot used during training. If we can reconstruct the evaluation metrics and the specific state of the training data from those notes, I am comfortable with a human in the loop for every release. This sacrifices the speed of automated versioning, but I accept that trade to guarantee that every store manager can verify the model behind their order suggestion. The critical requirement is that the manual record is complete enough to reproduce the exact forecast output, even if it means we spend an extra hour documenting each weekly retraining cycle.
output.reclassify_reason: The author explicitly accepts sacrificing the speed of automated versioning in exchange for the ability to verify model reproducibility and completeness.
